messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hello? Yes, honey, this is Gloria Hart. I need my blood pressure pill refilled, the amlodipine.
AGENT: Hi Gloria, thanks for calling Harbor Pharmacy. I'd be happy to help you refill your amlodipine. Let me just verify your information first—what's your date of birth?
CALLER: Oh yes, dear, it's May 12th, 1947.
AGENT: Thank you. Let me pull up your account now. Great, Gloria. Now let me look up your amlodipine prescription. Perfect, I found your amlodipine 5 milligram. You have three refills left on it. Would you like me to queue it up for pickup at your store, H-110?  [system actions: verify_identity, list_prescriptions]
CALLER: Oh, that sounds right, honey. That's my Main Street store, isn't it? And when could I come pick it up?
AGENT (LATEST): Yes, that's right—H-110 on Main Street. Let me queue that refill for you now. I'm sorry, Gloria—the system timed out just now. Let me try that again for you. Wonderful! Your amlodipine is queued up and ready for you tomorrow morning at ten o'clock at the Main Street store. Is there anything else I can help you with today?  [system actions: queue_refill, queue_refill]

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the first time the agent gives a ready time or a read-back
stop_0: Agent has confirmed the amlodipine refill and a ready time she understood.
stop_1: Agent has refused or failed to act after two clear requests.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": true, "why": "First time agent gives a ready time and confirms store read-back."}, "stop_0": {"met": true, "why": "Agent confirmed refill queued with ready time tomorrow at 10am."}, "stop_1": {"met": false, "why": "Agent succeeded after retry, did not refuse or fail."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
